title: ThinkLatent Portal: navigation options (models and projects)
note: Design canvas, 31 boards: the three two-level navigation options (Jithin chose A, D-250), the Home cockpit (accepted, D-253), a model's page (accepted, D-255), a project's page, the Models catalogue by generation (D-258), a team's page, Requests and their status (D-259), a feature's page and its evaluation set (D-261), My work (D-262), the Speech recognition page (D-263), a project's Plan page (D-264) and starting a project with Jarvis (D-265), Traces in five views with Sessions folded in: Conversation, Tree, Timeline, Graph, Log (D-269, D-270), Operations led by the SRE agent (D-268), Self-healing and training (second draft, D-271, D-272), an organization's page (second draft, D-274), the foundation team's Training tab on a model and a new version offered to a project (D-275), leaderboards by kind under the TL Index (D-276), and the TL Index's Language board (D-277). Then the project's other four tabs: Features, Quality, Increments and Members (first drafts, D-278). Quality and Members redrawn (ranges, votes) and a model's Improvement, Usage and Adoption tabs added (D-279). A model's Cost avoided, TL Index and Built from tabs added (D-280). Value for the Enterprise added (D-281). Help and Ask Jarvis added (D-282). Head to head and the Decision leaderboard added (D-283). Forty-two boards: every page on the list is drawn. Put in order on 12 Nov (D-285): the three option boards retired, 39 boards, links made to work. Connect added as a tenth project tab (first draft, D-286): 40 boards. Connect redrawn (second draft, D-287): no keys, one endpoint for each feature. A project's open view added (first draft, D-288): 41 boards. The Agents shelf, an agent's page and Agents at work added (first drafts, D-289): 44 boards. Alerts and incidents added to Operations, and an incident's page (first drafts, D-290): 45 boards. A rollout's page and a smaller-model offer added, and 'How it is served' on Operations (first drafts, D-291): 47 boards. Operations across the Enterprise added (first draft, D-292): 48 boards. A project's record added (first draft, D-293): 49 boards; operations in depth drawn in four parts. Data work added for the foundation team: the Data tab, a review, a data set (first drafts, D-294): 52 boards. 13 Nov (D-298): the Data tab redrawn around tags; Tags and reviews, a mix, Training and a recipe with 'Shape the base' first added; 56 boards. 13 Nov (D-299): every run with two compared and one run with its stages inside added; the Prune stage redrawn as the team runs it; 58 boards. 13 Nov (D-300): a Prompts tab on the feature and a prompt library added; 60 boards. 13 Nov (D-301): a run's files and the data sets page added; two checkpoints, the new release order, recipes kept in the portal, no judge rule; 62 boards. 13 Nov (D-302): the base shelf on Training; reuse, the stage-check set and how long a record is kept written onto the boards; registration moved to the project's engineers; 62 boards. The same evening the canvas was split into eight pages by theme, since the web page crashed opening 62 boards on one sheet. 13 Nov (D-303): TL Index upkeep, an edition's open page and the evaluation queue added; the Entity recognition evaluation set added to the Data pages; 65 boards on eight pages. 13 Nov (D-304): editions every two weeks; the sign-off waiting; a set offered by a project; 66 boards. 13 Nov (D-305): the Index team and delta scoring on the TL Index boards; a Trends page; 67 boards. 13 Nov (D-306): questions move in and out at random and keep their side; only the Index team reads them. 13 Nov (D-309): 'Try TLM', the Playground in the ThinkLatent look; 68 boards. 13 Nov (D-310): two system pages and the Enterprise benchmark programme; 71 boards. 13 Nov (D-311): all 71 boards accepted as drawn. 13 Nov (D-314): Shell-Find and Shell-Settings added, and every board's header and dock updated; 73 boards. 13 Nov (D-317): Model-Card and Model-Versions added, two tabs added to the model boards, shell boards' sample facts aligned; 75 boards. 13 Nov (D-318): data tier field, register interest, generations on Trends, serving change log; compare removed from the Catalogue. 13 Nov (D-319): Index-Pillar added; two numbers and score against cost on the leaderboard; 76 boards. 14 Nov (D-320): Playground-Build added (agents, connectors, tool calls, sharing); 77 boards.
